fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire property is chain-link fenced on all four sides (confirmed in 6 Street View frames). Trucks enter via a gated opening on the SE/east access drive; no open uncontrolled curb cut.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at any entrance in 2019/2022/2024 Street View. Kroger-owned plant served by dedicated carrier Quickway; likely kiosk/call-box or known-carrier check-in -> marked remoteGs. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long south-facing dock bank, 50+ doors with trailers and stainless milk tankers backed in (SV + z19 sat).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive Quickway trailer drop-yard rows west of the building plus tanker/trailer staging on the south/SE; well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and ample yard width at the SE drive; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Livonia/Detroit-metro industrial fabric; surrounded by other large DCs (QuikTrip building directly south).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; the E-W corridor to the north is a service road, not a live spur into the dairy.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~14.6 ac from the traced fenced perimeter (~296 m x ~195 m).
